topic: Components of rotor mast, control system, swash plate, torque link, drag damper, droop restrainer, clutch mechanism, rotor brake, feathering

specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the helicopter control, main rotor movements, translation flight, power, auto rotation, vibration checks and various adjustments.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of the main rotor mast?
How does the swash plate convert pilot input into blade pitch changes?
Why is the droop restrainer critical during engine failure?
